smell_validity.evidence: Twelve flag-derived settings for one node's reboot cycle recur as unrelated positional arguments at four signatures (main's launch, the loop, Drain, UncordonAfterReboot); adjacent same-typed durations make positional transposition silently wrong on incident-critical code, while the labels helpers' natural signatures mark the healthy boundary.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Every new drain or notify setting must cross four signatures positionally across two packages; the loop's 21-parameter union and adjacent same-typed durations repeatedly invite silent transposition. Removal restores a single settings owner and a clear command-versus-nodeops boundary, but the gain is confined to this control path, not architecture-level.

development_plausibility.evidence: Drain, uncordon and annotation bodies were lifted verbatim from the command; pkg/nodeops sits beside visible peers (taints, timewindow, blockers); the doc comments rationalize explicit parameter passing like a real author. The deglobalized 21-argument loop is a believable first-pass extraction compromise with no task-shaped scaffolding.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The contract fixes problem, finished state and preservation boundary: flags, lock, taints, drain ordering, annotation timing, and the silent-versus-notifying uncordon asymmetry that no existing test covers. It preempts catch-all records, per-signature re-wrapping and peer-package redesign while leaving type membership and placement open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Decisions differ by site: the launch and loop must split cycle configuration from run control (period, forceReboot, annotateNodes, taint), Drain consumes drain-plus-notify-plus-preLabels, Uncordon only postLabels, and UncordonAfterReboot keeps notify-after-success — three-plus purposes needing different membership decisions.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt describes the whole scope (command path plus node lifecycle package); listing nodeops files, its single caller and main's launch finds everything. Labels/annotation helpers are inspected and excluded trivially since they carry no settings; no aliases, callbacks or cross-component data flow.

repair_coordination.evidence: One struct must satisfy producer and consumers: main populates from flags, the loop forwards, three operations read different fields; a field missed at construction silently zero-values lifecycle behavior. The notify asymmetry must survive at both uncordon call sites — partial changes compile yet diverge behavior.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform extraction — a settings struct populated once in main and passed at every signature — covers all sites (launch, loop, Drain, Uncordon, UncordonAfterReboot) with no per-location behavioral decision, so over 80% of locations fall to a single rule.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Unifying the uncordon notify paths or transposing adjacent same-typed drain durations compiles and passes the existing URL/flag/lock tests; the first misfires only on the drain-failure path, the second changes real cluster behavior. The prompt confirms no lifecycle tests exist.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
